title: MAVAN QA finding
description: One root-cause finding. Every QA tool emits these. Repeats of the same rule on the same component collapse into one finding with many occurrences.

id.description: Stable hash of rule + component key, so reruns match.

rule.description: Rule id from qa/rules.json, e.g. geo.parent-overflow.

tier.description: fault = objective, may fail a build. smell = report only, never fails.

baseline.description: What the check compared against. none = baseline-free fault.

summary.description: One plain sentence: expected vs actual.

component.description: data-section/data-variant/data-slot key if tagged, else a stable selector.

url.description: Page path, never a full URL.

evidence.description: Path to screenshot or json under the run folder.

suppression.description: Approved-exception reason, from the component registry. Required when status = suppressed.

provenance.description: Optional. e.g. 'element present in prior build, absent now'. Captures deleted or relocated things outside the change being made.

proposedFix.description: Advice only. Tools never apply fixes.
